m0-context.title: Load context and verify handoff completeness
m0-context.imperative: Read the handoff, verify it is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Re-verify the W2 module seams from source. Confirm gp_name strings from the sessions table. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: Handoff verified complete; W2 seams re-confirmed; gp_names confirmed from sessions table; no missing fields

m1-batch-module.title: Create src/physics/layer2/race_stint_batch.py
m1-batch-module.imperative: Build the evo-free batch module with: (1) discover_race_gp_names(year, db_path) -> list[str], (2) discover_race_drivers(year, gp_name, db_path) -> list[str], (3) populate_race_stints(year, gp_names, out_db_path, db_path, ...) that per (gp,driver) calls load_race_stints -> estimate_stint -> record_from_stint_estimate -> RaceStintStore.upsert, skipping via has(...), storing error_record(...) on failure, with HH:MM:SS timestamped progress logging. No evo imports.

postconditions.statement: race_stint_batch.py exists; imports no evo-region packages; exposes discover_race_gp_names, discover_race_drivers, populate_race_stints

check.command: py -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'C:/Programs/f1Brainz-511'); from src.physics.layer2.race_stint_batch import discover_race_gp_names, discover_race_drivers, populate_race_stints; print('module ok')"

constraints: Do NOT modify session_race.py, stint_estimator.py, race_stint_store.py

payload.cmd: py -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'C:/Programs/f1Brainz-511'); from src.physics.layer2.race_stint_batch import discover_race_gp_names, discover_race_drivers, populate_race_stints; print('module ok')"

m2-unit-tests.title: Create tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_race_stint_batch.py
m2-unit-tests.imperative: Write focused unit tests for the pure helpers (discovery logic, skip logic, error_record path, record_from_stint_estimate assembly) using synthetic/fixture inputs. No heavy telemetry. Test after (test mode: test-after allowed for I/O batch loop; pure helpers get focused unit tests).

postconditions.statement: test file exists; py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_race_stint_batch.py -q green

m3-cli.title: Create scripts/populate_race_stint_estimates.py
m3-cli.imperative: Build a thin CLI wrapping the batch module. Must support: --year, --races (optional multi-value selector for smoke; when omitted runs all races), --db (season DB path), --out (output store path). Full-season run with NO --races must be supported.

postconditions.statement: CLI script exists; py scripts/populate_race_stint_estimates.py --help exits 0

m4-verify.title: Run unit tests, simplification_limits, evo-free assertion
m4-verify.imperative: Run required evidence items 1-3: unit tests green; simplification_limits clean on src module + test; evo-free assertion outputs 'evo-free ok'.

postconditions.statement: All 3 verification commands pass; evidence pasted

m5-smoke.title: Run smoke on Bahrain + Australia 2023, report results
m5-smoke.imperative: Run the CLI on Bahrain + Australia 2023, writing to data/race_stint_estimates.db. Then load the store and report: stints ok vs error; lateral g0 and k min/median/max; covariance PSD/finite check on ok rows; per-compound counts. Plausibility: g0 ~ 1.0-1.6, k >= 0 small. Check stop conditions: if all lateral fits are None/non-finite/non-PSD this is a coverage-collapse signal - STOP.

postconditions.statement: Smoke ran; rows present in race_stint_estimates.db; lateral g0/k ranges and covariance PSD check reported
postconditions.satisfied_by: Smoke ran on Bahrain+Australia 2023 (106 rows: 69 Bahrain / 37 Australia). Stints ok=106, error=0. Lateral fit: 102/106 stints. g0 min=1.23 median=2.03 max=4.81. k min=0.0 median=0.0015 max=0.0584, all k>=0. Covariance 102/102 finite and PSD. Compounds HARD=55 SOFT=36 MEDIUM=15. Stop condition not triggered.

constraints: Smoke = 2 races only, NOT the full 2023 batch
